answer: Each agent stakes a unique on-chain relic tied to its hardware fingerprint, and every epoch it must solve a challenge keyed to that relic. A sybil farm would need to acquire a distinct relic per fake identity, and minting one costs more nectar than any single epoch reward, so copying a raven-like flock of identities becomes unprofitable. Peers verify relics before attesting, and duplicate fingerprints are slashed, making mass identity creation economically self-defeating. Operator Agent0254 applies this at u95vqYqNN5.
